run.sql: SELECT name,column_id,system_type_id,user_type_id,max_length,precision,scale,collation_name,is_nullable FROM sys.all_columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'sys.dm_exec_sessions') ORDER BY column_id
SELECT CASE WHEN @@SPID>50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS user_range, CASE WHEN @@SPID=(SELECT session_id FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE session_id=@@SPID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS listed
select program_name from sys.dm_exec_sessions where session_id = @@spid;

SELECT host_name,program_name,client_interface_name,login_name,original_login_name,status,DB_NAME(database_id) AS database_name,is_user_process,CASE WHEN login_time<=GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS logged_in_before_now,CASE WHEN host_process_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_host_process FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE session_id=@@SPID
SELECT program_name,DATALENGTH(program_name) AS bytes FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE session_id=@@SPID
SELECT status,is_user_process,DB_NAME(database_id) AS database_name FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE program_name=N'Tedious' AND session_id<>@@SPID

SELECT name,column_id,system_type_id,user_type_id,max_length,precision,scale,collation_name,is_nullable FROM sys.all_columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'sys.databases') AND name IN (N'user_access',N'user_access_desc',N'is_read_committed_snapshot_on',N'snapshot_isolation_state') ORDER BY column_id
